demos.stdout_tail:
usage: gz content unown [-h] --section SECTION [--attestor ATTESTOR]
                        [--reason REASON] [--quiet | --verbose] [--debug]
                        surface

Un-own a 'corpus-owned' section, the one legitimate move that RAISES the decrease-only unowned-byte ratchet (`gz content remember`'s ordinary path is decrease-or-equal only). Same corpus-attestation shape as `gz content retire`: empty or whitespace-only --attestor or --reason exits non-zero and writes nothing -- un-owning a section is a canon change every time, so it never reaches an unchanged-canon exemption (unlike `gz content commit`). On success, emits a section_ownership_unowned ledger event carrying the section id, the prior and new unowned-byte floor, the attestor, and the reason.

positional arguments:
  surface              Control surface the section belongs to (e.g.
                       AGENTS.md).

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --section SECTION    Section id to un-own (kebab-case).
  --attestor ATTESTOR  Operator un-owning the section; required and never
                       empty.
  --reason REASON      Why the section is being un-owned; required and never
                       empty.
  --quiet, -q          Suppress non-error output
  --verbose, -v        Enable verbose output
  --debug              Enable debug mode with full tracebacks

Examples
    gz content unown AGENTS.md --section attestation --attestor "g0" --reason "materialized as prose doc instead"

Exit codes
    0   Success
    1   User/config error
    2   System/IO error
    3   Policy breach

demos.command: uv run python -c "import subprocess, sys, pathlib; d = pathlib.Path('.gzkit/ownership/AGENTS.md.json'); before = d.read_bytes(); r = subprocess.run(['uv','run','gz','content','unown','AGENTS.md','--section','attestation','--attestor','','--reason','probe'], capture_output=True, text=True); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode != 0 and d.read_bytes() == before else 1)"

uv run python -c "import json, pathlib; from gzkit.content.models import Corpus; from gzkit.content.ownership import compute_baseline; d = json.loads(pathlib.Path('.gzkit/ownership/AGENTS.md.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')); corpus = Corpus.loads(pathlib.Path('.gzkit/corpus/AGENTS.md.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8')); b = compute_baseline(pathlib.Path('AGENTS.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'), corpus); print('owned', sum(1 for v in d['sections'].values() if v == 'corpus-owned'), '| unowned floor', d['unowned_byte_floor'], '| coverage', b.coverage_pct)"
